.. change::
    :tags: sql server, feature
    :tickets: 11620

    Added the ``mssql_enable_identity_insert`` execution option as the
    explicit replacement for SQL Server's automatic ``IDENTITY_INSERT``
    detection.  The legacy behavior remains enabled by default through the
    ``legacy_identity_insert`` dialect option and now emits a deprecation
    warning when it activates.  Setting ``legacy_identity_insert=False``
    disables the automatic behavior without affecting explicitly opted-in
    statements.
